title: Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI
summary: Cloudflare has previewed Clairic, a System One extraction model on Workers AI that returns typed values with confidence scores in one forward pass. It costs $0.10 per million input tokens and charges nothing for output. The post Cloudflare Releases Clairic, a System One Extraction Model on Workers AI appeared first on MarkTechPost .
